posts.body_html:
holy crapola bristol, didn't see those pics until now, that red throat is intense! Great job bringing out the colors in this clone, it's not an easy feat, and I think they can probably get even more colorful.

This year, the clone produced a pretty darn big trap with a big old "head." In the past, plants that have produced traps this size on a normal sized rhizome produced gigantic traps, and I think this plant is no exception. It also has hybrid vigor, so it has the right genetic traits to produce biggie traps.

Here's some update pics of my moorei extreme red throat 'select,' pics taken 6/1/20:
